title: Integrative machine learning and gene regulatory network analysis identifies novel genes for leafy head formation in Brassica rapa and B. oleracea.
authors: Sun, Wei; Wu, Jian; Cai, Xu; Chen, Yue; van Dijk, Aalt D J; Wang, Xiaowu; Bonnema, Guusje
one_liner_zh: 该研究用机器学习与基因调控网络分析鉴定叶球形成相关基因，虽涉及转录因子但无蛋白-DNA互作建模或结合机制研究，仅属基因调控网络层面的间接关联。
abstract: Leafy head formation is a crucial developmental process in Brassica crops. Here, an integrative approach combining machine learning and gene regulatory network analysis was employed to identify novel genes involved in leafy head formation in Chinese cabbage (Brassica rapa) and cabbage (Brassica oleracea). Random Forest models, trained with 47 known leafy head-related genes, demonstrated robust performance with mean AUC values of 0.87 and 0.85 for B. rapa and B. oleracea, respectively. By filtering the model predictions, we identified 11 genes predicted with high confidence which were shared between both species. To further reveal the regulatory mechanisms, we constructed gene regulatory networks for genes in both species. By integrating ML predictions with these networks, we identified key regulatory clusters specifically related to leafy head formation. Network centrality analysis revealed many core genes in key clusters, including important transcription factors such as ANT, GRF2, GRF3, and TCX3, suggesting crucial roles in leafy head formation across the two species. The parallel detection of the same genes and similar network structures in the two species supports the validity of our findings. Our integrative approach provides novel insights into the genetic regulation of leafy head formation and sets the stage for future functional studies of Brassica species.
abstract_zh: 叶球形成是芸薹属作物中一个关键的发育过程。本研究采用结合机器学习与基因调控网络分析的综合方法，以鉴定大白菜（Brassica rapa）和结球甘蓝（Brassica oleracea）中叶球形成相关的新基因。利用47个已知叶球相关基因训练的随机森林模型，在B. rapa和B. oleracea中分别表现出稳健的性能，平均AUC值为0.87和0.85。通过筛选模型预测结果，我们鉴定出11个在两个物种间共享且高置信度预测的基因。为进一步揭示调控机制，我们构建了两个物种中这些基因的基因调控网络。通过将机器学习预测与这些网络整合，我们识别出与叶球形成特异相关的关键调控簇。网络中心性分析揭示了许多关键簇中的核心基因，包括重要的转录因子如ANT、GRF2、GRF3和TCX3，表明它们在这两个物种的叶球形成中发挥关键作用。两个物种中相同基因的平行检测和相似网络结构支持了我们发现的有效性。我们的综合方法为叶球形成的遗传调控提供了新见解，并为未来芸薹属物种的功能研究奠定了基础。
